info.title: Agilis Advertising webhooks
info.description:
The messages Agilis sends to the webhook endpoints of an approved business when its Offers, Events, balance or account change.

Each message is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body to an endpoint the business registered in the Ad Portal or with the REST API (`POST /webhook-endpoints`). Verify the `Agilis-Signature` header with the endpoint secret before trusting the body, answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds, and ignore an `id` you have already handled. Messages can arrive more than once and out of order. TEST endpoints receive TEST changes only, LIVE endpoints LIVE changes only.

yourEndpoint.title: Your webhook endpoint
yourEndpoint.description: The https address you registered (port 443, a public address). Agilis connects to it; it does not connect to Agilis.

webhookEndpoint.title: Your webhook endpoint
webhookEndpoint.description: The address of each endpoint that listens for the message's type, or for every type (`*`).

sendWebhookEvent.title: Send a webhook event
sendWebhookEvent.summary: Agilis POSTs one signed message for each change, to every matching endpoint, and retries until it is accepted.
sendWebhookEvent.description: LIVE messages are retried for up to 3 days, sooner at first and then every 12 hours; TEST messages three times over about 2½ hours. An endpoint with no successful delivery for 3 days is turned off; you can turn it back on in the Ad Portal or with `PATCH /webhook-endpoints/{endpoint_id}`.

Agilis-Signature.description: `t=<Unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the endpoint secret>`; one `v1` per active secret while a rolled one is still valid.

Agilis-Webhook-Id.description: The webhook event id, the same as `id` in the body.

Offer.description: An Offer: a time-limited deal shown to Agilis members near the business, in the mode of the API key that reads it.

advertised_name.description: The business name members see; `null` when your trading name is shown.

push_notification_title.description: The notification members who opted in get when the offer starts. `null` on offers created before these fields existed: those offers are never sent as a notification.

push_notification_message.description: The notification members who opted in get when the offer starts. `null` on offers created before these fields existed: those offers are never sent as a notification.

button_preset.description: The button's text: `claim_offer`, `visit_website`, `install_app`, `book_now`, `get_directions` or `custom`. `claim_offer` on offers created before the button text could be chosen.

button_text.description: Your own button text when `button_preset` is `custom`; otherwise `null`.

image.description: Signed URL of the image. It expires, so do not store it.

gender.description: For example `["Male","Female"]`; empty when the offer targets every gender.

interests.description: `{interest_id, interest_name}` objects; empty when no interest targeting was applied.

offer_status.description: Awaiting Payment, Active, Scheduled, Paused or Ended.

status.description: `enabled` or `disabled`: whether an Admin has disabled the offer.

Event.description: An Event listing shown in the Events tab of the Agilis apps, in the mode of the API key that reads it.

Category.description: An Offer category, or an Event category.

category_id.description: Unique ID of the category. Example: `1`

Interest.description: An interest that an Offer can target.

interest_id.description: Unique ID of the interest. Example: `3`

offerCreated.name: offer.created
offerCreated.title: offer.created
offerCreated.summary: An Offer was created: paid from your balance at once, or awaiting a card payment.

id.description: Unique id of this webhook event (whevt_…). The same on every retry and resend: use it to ignore duplicates.

created.description: When the change happened, in Unix seconds. Events can arrive out of order: use this to order them.

livemode.description: true for a LIVE endpoint, false for TEST.

test.description: Present and true only on a message sent with Send test event.

object.description: The Offer, in the same shape as an item of GET /offers.

payment_method.description: B: paid from your balance. E: awaiting payment by Stripe link.

amount_charged.description: What was deducted from your balance (payment_method B only).

amount_due.description: What the payment link asks for, before any VAT (payment_method E only).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the amounts, your billing currency. Example: GBP

source.description: What caused the change: your API key, the MCP server, the Ad Portal, Agilis, or the system (a scheduled start or end).

idempotency_key.description: The Idempotency-Key of the request that caused it, if any.
